node.statement: For X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{T,Q}, lem-compcb-amplified-compression identifies the column corner at level n, and column-hilbert-inner-product-displays gives the exact whole-column identity X^dagger dot X=q_T(X)^2*u_Q. Lem-compcb-rectangular-product and epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms then give | ||X^dagger dot X||-||X||^2 |<=(C_co+1)e||X||^2: compare X^dagger dot X to X^dagger X, use ||X^dagger||=||X||, and use (1-epsilon)||X||^2<=||X^dagger X||<=(1+epsilon)||X||^2.
node.inference: by definitions and norm triangle inequality
